pages.title: The Mayor's Mansion
paragraphs: The mayor's mansion stands at the top of the village, the only house with every window dark. Its door is not barred. For the first time on {island}, something has been left open for them.
Inside, the hall is warm and silent. Merfolk stand motionless along the walls, dripping onto the floorboards, and none of them turn to look. Cypher says nothing, but his hand goes to his tome.

At the far end, a tall figure sits in the mayor's chair, wrapped in the mayor's chain of office. Where a face should be there is a mass of pale tentacles, and it murmurs in a tongue that has no business being spoken by a throat. Maria has the sense that it was waiting for her.

pages.title: Sleeping Guards
paragraphs: Most of these Merfolk are on guard: they hold their ground until a unit steps into their reach. Select an enemy and check its behavior, or turn on Enemy Range to see where they will wake.
Approach in small steps and pull them one at a time. Walking into the middle of the hall will bring the whole room down on you.

pages.title: Locked Chests
paragraphs: Treasure chests line the upper rooms. Stand on a chest and choose Open to claim what is inside, though locked chests need a Chest Key.
Whatever the mayor hoarded in this house, something in it may explain what the village is hiding.
